lookback_summary: Well, that was a mixed bag of results for the model last weekend! It nailed the prediction for Fulham vs Man United, calling it a draw and getting it right. On the flip side, it had to eat humble pie on the Leeds vs Crystal Palace clash, where it went for a Home win but ended in a stalemate instead. There were some hits too, like Man City’s victory over Sunderland and Newcastle’s solid win against Hull City—both predicted correctly as home wins. However, the model was left scratching its head with Everton’s surprise win and Brighton's dominant display against Arsenal, both of which it didn’t see coming. Overall, a bit of a rollercoaster!
